meta_description:
398 likes, 54 comments - ilunarang on January 29, 2026: "Travelling has never felt this inclusive before.

We’ve all come to expect the basics at a stay - toothbrushes, towels, shower gels. But period care? That’s still treated like an afterthought. Plush @plushforher and @zostel are changing that. Across Zostels in India, period care is now being treated like what it should’ve always been - a basic, not a special request. No awkward asks, no last-minute panic. You’re handed a Plush period kit right at check-in, just like any other essential.

Because when you’re on the move, your period shouldn’t make you feel unprepared or uncomfortable.
So the next time you check into a Zostel, don’t forget to grab your exclusive Plush period kit 💗
Period care, finally made travel-friendly.
